import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys

root = Path('/home/joshua/lonely-runner-formalization')
inputs = Path('/tmp/astra-pass71-inputs.json')
manifest = json.loads(inputs.read_text())
bindings = manifest['hashes'] | manifest['dependency_hashes']
for name, digest in bindings.items():
    data = (root / name).read_bytes()
    assert hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() == digest, name
    assert data.endswith(b'\n'), name
    assert all(line.rstrip() == line for line in data.splitlines()), name
for review, sources in manifest['review_bindings'].items():
    text = (root / review).read_text()
    for source in sources:
        assert bindings[source] in text, (review, source)
control = json.loads((root / 'research/astra-ideal-mask-integer-control.json').read_text())
assert hashlib.sha256(control['execution']['source_utf8'].encode()).hexdigest() == control['execution']['source_sha256'] == '68cb123b610cf068c353c68c332bb1e5d34025675e68fab483c0751c77ec285e'
assert control['solver']['status'] == 'unknown'
assert control['solver']['configuration'] == {'timeout_ms': 60000, 'random_seed': 0, 'optimization': False, 'solver_check_calls': 1}
assert control['solver']['statistics']['num checks'] == '1'
assert control['certificate'] is None and control['certificate_validation'] is None
assert len(control['every_midpoint_integer_mask']) == 352
assert len(control['pairs_in_bit_order']) == 100
observed = control['actual_process_receipt']['solver_invocation']['completion_tool_observation']
assert observed['exit_status'] == 0 and observed['combined_output'] == ''
assert control['delivery_metrics']['worker_elapsed_seconds'] is None
assert control['delivery_metrics']['first_check_success'] is True
assert not Path('/tmp/ideal-mask-integer-control-z3-20260906').exists()
commands = []
for argv in ([sys.executable, '-B', 'scripts/validate_workflow.py'], ['git', 'diff', '--check'], [sys.executable, '-B', 'scripts/manage_storage.py']):
    result = subprocess.run(argv, cwd=root, text=True, capture_output=True)
    commands.append({'argv': argv, 'exit_code': result.returncode, 'stdout': result.stdout, 'stderr': result.stderr})
    assert result.returncode == 0, commands[-1]
receipt = {
    'checkpoint': 'Pass71',
    'parent_main': 'd0f1fee0850373e5b35a9883752d45b226d5f868',
